props.name: aria-label
props.description: When provided, a label is added to the action bar

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: When provided, uses the element with that ID as the accessible name for the ActionBar

props.name: flush
props.description: Allows ActionBar to be flush with the container

props.name: gap
props.description: Horizontal gap scale between items (restricted to none or condensed).

props.name: children
props.description: This will be the Button description.

props.name: icon
props.description: Provide an octicon. It will be placed in the center of the button

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Use an aria label to describe the functionality of the button. Please refer to [our guidance on alt text](https://primer.style/guides/accessibility/alternative-text-for-images) for tips on writing good alternative text.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Provides a disabled state for the button. The button will remain focusable, and have `aria-disabled` applied.

props.name: children
props.description: The text content of the button.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Provide an octicon to render before the button text. It will also be shown when the button overflows into the menu.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Provides a disabled state for the button. The button will remain focusable, and have `aria-disabled` applied.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the menu button.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of menu items to render in the menu. Each item can be an action, group, or divider.

props.name: overflowIcon
props.description: Icon displayed when the menu item is within the overflow menu. If 'none' is provided, no icon will be shown in the overflow menu.

props.name: returnFocusRef
props.description: A ref to an element that should receive focus when the menu is closed.
